cover.title: the founder the dma was written for

inner.title: steer users off-store
inner.body: the dma lets app developers tell users about cheaper offers outside the app store. apple was fined €500m on 23 april 2025 for blocking exactly that.
inner.label: €500m fine

inner.title: pull your data live
inner.body: gatekeepers must give business users free, real-time access to the data their business generates there. if you never ask, the platform keeps it alone.
inner.label: article 6(10)

inner.title: skip the app store
inner.body: alternative app stores like aptoide, epic games store and altstore run on apple's systems in the eu. your app can live there too, nobody sends invites.
inner.label: no invite coming

inner.title: demand fair ranking
inner.body: under article 6(5), google search must not rank its own services above similar third-party ones. the commission hasn't endorsed google's fixes, so check your results.
inner.label: screenshot it

inner.title: ask for interop
inner.body: gatekeepers must give third parties free access to the same os features their own services use. nobody grants access you never formally request.
inner.label: ask in writing
